role: Head of opening ceremony student ambassadors
appearance: Green ceremony jacket, light crossbody work bag, evacuation list in hand
motivation: Evacuate guests and make sure the player knows the current task
knows: The control centre is in Building 4 (CDS-1)
Ruibang can provide the recovery steps remotely
The player knows the ceremony route

dialogue.firstMeeting: Last check-in round. Once that is done you can go watch the robot show on the lawn.
dialogue.assignment: I can't leave. You know the route: go through the Central Building to the CDS-1 control centre. Ruibang will meet you there.
dialogue.repeat: Same objective: Building 4, the CDS-1 control centre.
dialogue.offTopic: Deal with the robot first; other questions can wait until everyone is safe.
dialogue.locked: Finish the check-in first; I need to confirm who is still in the dinner area.
dialogue.routeHint: Follow the arrows on the work terminal and head from Building 3 towards Building 4.
dialogue.complete: The lawn is safe. Good work; leave the rest to the rescue team.
dialogue.fallback: If the signal is bad, check the mission terminal; the target is already marked.
